name: responsive-dialog

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the open dialog centred with both fields, the close button and the Save button.

tagline: A profile form opens as a centred dialog, and as a bottom sheet on phones.
summary: One dialog that changes shape with the screen: a centred modal with a short form and Save button on desktop, and a bottom drawer on narrow screens, driven by the same set of parts.
appearance: On a near-black page a small outlined trigger button sits alone. Clicked, a rounded dark-grey panel appears in the middle with a title, a close X, two labelled text fields and a white Save changes button in a footer.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger dims the page and pops the centred panel, with the cursor landing in the Name field. The X closes it and focus returns to the button; below the breakpoint the same parts render as a bottom drawer instead.
demo_content: Profile form with Name 'Pedro Duarte' and Username '@peduarte', opened from an 'Edit Profile' button.
search_phrases: modal that turns into bottom sheet
popup form on desktop and mobile
slide up drawer on small screens
one component for dialog and drawer
use_when: The same form must be a dialog on desktop but a thumb-friendly bottom sheet on phones without writing two versions.
avoid_when: Screen width alone decides the shell on the client, so server rendering or odd viewports can pick the wrong one.
customise: Breakpoint width, open state and defaultOpen are props; colours and panel styling come from the dialog and drawer parts you import, and the form is yours to write.
weight_why: Renders one dialog or drawer; the cost is the imported Radix and Vaul primitives.

a11y.note: Radix and Vaul give a focus trap, Escape to close and labelled fields, but the clip never shows the mobile drawer.

issues: The clip only shows the desktop dialog; the mobile drawer that distinguishes it is never recorded.
polish_why: A clean, conventional dialog with coherent dark styling; nothing distinctive beyond the swap.
